description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Inline Loan Close Of Business (COB) functionality in the Fineract platform. It includes setup and test methods for verifying the inline COB execution on individual loans, batch processing, and handling of special scenarios like catch-up on delinquency or repayment with locked loans. The class leverages various helper classes to simulate loan lifecycle steps—creating clients, approving loans, disbursing, repaying, and executing COB logic while manipulating the business date context.

classes.name: InlineLoanCOBTest
classes.description: This class contains comprehensive integration tests for the inline COB functionality in Fineract. It extends BaseLoanIntegrationTest and sets up helper objects for executing COB logic, simulating loan lifecycle events, and manipulating the business date environment to verify correct COB execution behavior across different scenarios including catch-up, batch API, and loan lock conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes request and response specifications with appropriate headers and creates helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testInlineCOB
methods.description: Tests executing inline COB on a single loan and verifies the last closed business date updates appropriately after each COB run.

methods.name: testInlineCOBCatchUpLoans
methods.description: Verifies COB catch-up logic when updating the business date over multiple intervals, and checks delinquency tags are appropriately added.

methods.name: testInlineCOBOnRepaymentWithSoftLockedLoan
methods.description: Runs COB on a loan with a soft-locked account, performs a repayment, and verifies the last closed date updates correctly following COB execution.

methods.name: testInlineCOBCatchUpOnRepaymentWithNotLockedLoan
methods.description: Performs COB on a loan without account locks, executes repayment, and verifies update of the last closed business date.

methods.name: testInlineCOBOnBatchAPIWithOldRelativeUrls
methods.description: Tests COB execution with batch API requests using old relative URL formats, verifying the last closed date update after repayment.

methods.name: testInlineCOBOnBatchAPI
methods.description: Tests COB execution via batch API with current endpoints, verifying the last closed date update after loan repayment.

methods.name: testInlineCOBRequestBodyItemLimitValidation
methods.description: Validates that the COB API enforces a maximum request size (limit of 1000 loan IDs), returning a 400 error if exceeded.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product JSON with specified charge ID and return its ID.

methods.name: createLoanProduct (overloaded)
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specified delinquency bucket, returning its ID.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Creates a loan application with specified client ID, loan product ID, optional savings account, and disbursement date, returning the loan ID.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Adds collateral details to a list of collaterals.
